visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 images are dominated by random fine-grain speckle within the object boundary; no grid, band, or gradient patterns present. top_diff10 shows a faint tile-correlated texture consistent with existing known tile_structure_ratio ~17, unchanged from prior KEEP iters.

reasoning: All visual gates pass. Renders are perceptually identical to reference across all three views; diff10 images show the same diffuse speckle pattern as prior KEEP iters with no new grid seams, holes, clipping, or geometry shifts. Tile_structure_ratio is bit-identical to the last five KEEP iters (max 17.587, delta 0.000 vs prev_best) — the existing mild tile structure is a known pre-existing condition from iter-010 and is not worsened here. PSNR hero/top are below the nominal 40 dB kernel-algebra floor but identical to iter-054/057 which were both KEEP; per project memory the perceptual floor is 35-40 dB + clean visuals. Timing is essentially flat at +0.03% vs prev_best (24.676 vs 24.6685 ms), within the 1.02x break-even threshold. p99/median ratio is 1.20x, well under the 3x suspicious-tail threshold. Per-view PSNR spread is 2.6 dB and per-view ms ratio is 1.23x, both within bounds. Verdict: KEEP — code-restructure iter with bit-identical quality and flat timing.
